mapper.select: select g.id, g.member_id as memberId, coalesce((select max(c.level) from growth_level_config c where c.need_exp is not null and c.need_exp <= g.exp_value), 1) as levelNo, g.exp_value as expValue, g.last_active_time as lastActiveTime, g.create_time as createTime, g.update_time as updateTime from member_growth g where g.member_id = #{memberId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into member_growth (member_id, level_no, exp_value, last_active_time, create_time, update_time) values (#{memberId}, #{levelNo}, #{expValue}, #{lastActiveTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}) on duplicate key update update_time = values(update_time)
